questions.question: What is the mean of the numbers 2, 4, 6, 8, 10?
What is the median of the numbers 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11?
questions.explanation: For even number of values, median is average of middle two: (5+7)/2 = 6

questions.question: What is the mode of the numbers 2, 3, 3, 4, 5, 3, 6?
questions.explanation: Mode is the most frequent value, which is 3 (appears 3 times)

questions.question: What is the range of the numbers 10, 15, 20, 25, 30?
What is the probability of rolling a 6 on a fair six-sided die?
questions.explanation: Probability = Number of favorable outcomes / Total outcomes = 1/6

questions.question: What is the standard deviation of the numbers 2, 4, 6, 8, 10?
What is the variance of the numbers 1, 3, 5, 7, 9?
What is the probability of drawing a red card from a standard deck of 52 cards?
questions.explanation: There are 26 red cards (hearts + diamonds) out of 52 total cards = 26/52 = 1/2

questions.question: What is the z-score for a value of 75 if the mean is 70 and standard deviation is 5?
What is the correlation coefficient if r² = 0.64?
questions.explanation: r = √r² = √0.64 = 0.8 (correlation can be positive or negative)
